settings.question: Can I add modules later?
settings.answer: Yes. The hutch, side locker and side drawers bolt on to the base cabinet, and the side units can go on the left or the right. Start with the base and expand when you are ready.

settings.question: Can the side units be used on their own?
settings.answer: Yes. The side locker and side drawers work as stand-alone units and have pre-drilled caster holes underneath for optional mobility.

settings.question: How much weight do the drawers hold?
settings.answer: Each drawer rides on 150 lb capacity full-extension slides, so heavy tools can live in any drawer, front to back.

settings.question: Which foam should I pick?
settings.answer: Peel foam is the quick route: trace the tool and peel the layers to depth, no cutting tools needed. High-density EVA sheets are for CNC machining or laser cutting. The pre-cut bundles match the Ultra Task and Mega Max drawers. If you want it done for you, order custom foam inserts and send us your tool list.

settings.question: What is a rotary screw air compressor?
settings.answer: A rotary screw compressor uses two interlocking helical rotors to compress air in a continuous flow, instead of a piston pumping in strokes. That lets it run 100% of the time without overheating, hold pressure steady and deliver more air per horsepower, which is why it is the standard for shops that use air for hours at a stretch.

settings.question: What size compressor does a busy auto or body shop need?
settings.answer: Add up the CFM at 90 psi of every air tool you will run at the same time, then add about 30% headroom. This 20 HP unit is built for multi-bay shops running sanders, impacts and spray guns at once, with the 500 L tank buffering the peaks. Send us your tool list and we will confirm the sizing.

settings.question: Does this compressor need three-phase power?
settings.answer: Yes. A 20 HP motor requires 3-phase electrical service with a properly sized breaker and feeder. Most commercial and industrial buildings have it; a home shop can use a phase converter. Confirm your supply with a licensed electrician before ordering.

settings.question: Do I need to buy a separate air dryer?
settings.answer: No. A refrigerated air dryer is built into this package, so you get clean, dry air out of the box. That matters for spray finishing, plasma cutting and the life of your air tools. Point-of-use filtration can be added for specific processes.

settings.question: Is this worth it for a home garage?
settings.answer: For a serious home shop (restoration, fabrication, a car collection) yes: it is quiet, gives you clean dry air with no bolt-on dryer, runs any tool without waiting, and it is the last compressor you will buy. It does need 3-phase power or a phase converter. For occasional tire-and-nailer use it is more than you need. Send us your setup and we will be straight with you.

settings.question: How is it delivered and installed?
settings.answer: It ships free on a pallet anywhere in Canada, or you can pick it up in Richmond, Vancouver or Calgary. Position it with a pallet jack or forklift on a level pad. Hookup needs a licensed electrician for the 3-phase connection and a compressed-air installer for piping and drains.

settings.question: CFM vs. PSI: what should I size against?
settings.answer: PSI is pressure, and almost any compressor makes enough of it. CFM (airflow) at working pressure is what runs your tools continuously, so size against the combined CFM of everything running at once.
